response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT f.film_id, f.rating, COUNT(i.inventory_id) AS copies FROM film f LEFT JOIN inventory i ON i.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id, f.rating) SELECT film_id, rating, copies, copies - AVG(copies) OVER (PARTITION BY rating) AS diff_from_rating_avg, copies - AVG(copies) OVER () AS diff_from_overall_avg FROM c ORDER BY diff_from_overall_avg DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Every film in the film table counts as a film, including films with no inventory copies, which count as 0 copies. The averages are taken over all films, and the overall average is over films rather than over the rating averages.
The per-rating average is the average copies per film among films with that rating. The differences are copies minus the average, unrounded.

alternatives.interpretation: Only films that have at least one inventory copy count as films. Films with no copies are excluded from both averages.
